## review follow-ups of PR #34006 (card #33923, the `scenario-eval` internal skill and the `eval-run` record)

Record: 6897354155 (at-tier review on head `3d9dedb1`; items outside that PR's file surface).

- [ ] S1 the `eval-run` record label is unknown to the sweeps. The skill forbids priority, `domain:*` and `pm:*` labels on the record for its whole life, as checklist-test does for `qa-run`, but only `qa-run` is exempt in code: `scripts/pm/first-touch-sweep.mjs` `EXCLUDED_LABELS`, and `H13_EXEMPT_LABELS` / `H74_EXEMPT_LABELS` in `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`. An `eval-run` record left open while a finding waits is owed a first touch the skill forbids. Add `eval-run` beside `qa-run` in each list (with a self-test pin each) and in the triage rule phrase that names `qa-run`.
- [ ] R1 `.claude/skills/scenario-eval/SKILL.md` has no row in `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` `CEILINGS` (an enumeration; nothing derives `.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md` from the tree, so the gate cannot red on it). Seed a row at the measured line count; 26 of its lines exceed 120 bytes, so the width pin seeds at the measurement; the header's "the four other `.claude/skills/` playbook SKILL.md files" becomes five.

`scripts/pm/**` tooling; `skip-changeset`; `Clause-②: no`. Waits for PR #34006.

⛔ Not a claim. Grading is triage's.
